card.name: Subsection digit in label cross-references
card.fires_on: The digit after the dot in a numbered section cross-reference, such as (2.1) or (5.1), in the highlights of a drug label. It fires on the number that follows the section number and a period.

modes.label: Dosage section reference
modes.description: Subsection number inside a (2.x) pointer to Dosage and Administration after a dosing statement.
modes.example: Repeat cycle every 4 weeks. ( 2.<<1>> ) 2.1 Recommended Dosage

modes.label: Warnings or reactions reference
modes.description: Subsection number in a pointer to Warnings, Adverse Reactions or Clinical Pharmacology.
modes.example: [see Adverse Reactions ( 6.<<1>> )] . Avoid or interrupt LEQ
